Definition: a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men)
BiblicalUsage: 1) small cattle, sheep, sheep and goats, flock, flocks; 1a) small cattle (usually of sheep and goats); 1b) of multitude (simile); 1c) of multitude (metaphor)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
